name: braftonium
description: Root build orchestrator for the Braftonium plugin. Builds every component (blocks: legacy SCSS + React blocks, and the gutenberg-addon JS) with one command: `npm run build`.

scripts.install:all: npm run install:blocks && npm run install:addon
scripts.compile: npm run build:blocks && npm run build:addon
scripts.build: npm run install:all && npm run compile
